item.tib: dkar mo tshe yi bsgrub pa
item.coloph: dkar mo tshe'i bsgrub (sgrub) pa/ las kyi sgyur kha dang bca' ba/ gces pa yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba/ smar ro/ hris pa'i man ngag dr-in pa'i snying tegs (tig) 'di/ gsang la bsgrub pas rngos (dngos) grub 'byung ngo / las 'phro can la 'phrad par shog/
